title: Version 2.1.78 Release
description: Added StopFailure hook event, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA variable for plugin state, and frontmatter support for plugin agents. Fixed numerous issues including git log failures, session history truncation, and security fixes for sandbox mode.

title: Major Agentic Capabilities Improvements for JetBrains IDEs
description: Core agentic capabilities including custom agents, sub-agents, and plan agent are now generally available. Added agent hooks in preview, auto-approve support for MCP, enhanced model selection, and thinking panel for extended-reasoning models.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot's new agent mode is capable of iterating on its own code, recognizing errors, and fixing them automatically
Low-to-medium complexity tasks, capable of adding features, fixing bugs, refactoring, and improving tests

title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Students
description: Students with GitHub Education benefits are now on the new GitHub Copilot Student plan with updated model lineup, focusing on sustainable AI-native learning tools.

title: GPT-5.2-Codex Model Support
description: Added support for GPT-5.2-Codex with four reasoning efforts (low, medium, high, and xhigh), OpenAI's latest model designed for agentic coding.

community_feedback.quote: GPT-5.2 Codex High ran for 55 minutes with no output, progress, or meaningful results

title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Installation
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App on both desktop and mobile devices via Chrome or Edge browsers, improving accessibility and user experience.

title: Version 0.33.0 - Agent Architecture Enhancements
description: Introduced HTTP authentication for A2A remote agents and authenticated A2A agent cards. Enhanced @file autocomplete functionality and various bug fixes.

title: March 2026 Updates
description: Multiple updates to the Codex CLI including improvements to network proxy handling, branching threads, and external editor editing capabilities.
